summary: Umpqua National Forest, Lane County: listed as an early patrol lookout site on the 5,994 ft summit; no source describes a structure there today.

facts.status_note: Listed as an early patrol lookout site; no source describes a tower or cabin on the summit today.

access.note: Reached on foot by the Bohemia Mountain Trail, which leads up a steep grade to the summit.

visit.trail_note: About 1.6 miles round trip to the summit; directions start in Cottage Grove, heading east on Road 2400 toward Dorena Lake.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The only lookout-specific source is the Weebly entry ('An early patrol lookout site.') with no year, height or structure. No NHLR or FFLOS record for Bohemia Mountain was found: the register URL guesses returned 404 from the cache. Fairview Peak (US 472, OR 69) is a separate lookout on a different summit; do not merge the two records. The record's coordinates (43.57429, -122.657) differ by about 90 m from the Wikipedia/GNIS point (43.57512, -122.65628); probably harmless. Status left unset: sources describe a lookout site, not a standing or removed tower. Reads: 5 pages plus 2 failed register lookups (about 6 counted against the budget, the Weebly page read twice). Searches: 1 (websearch.py).
